parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.client_slug, a.patient_phone_e164, a.patient_first_name, a.specialty, a.updated_at FROM appointments a WHERE a.status = 'concretado' AND a.review_requested_at IS NULL AND a.updated_at BETWEEN now() - interval '4 hours' AND now() - interval '2 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_state cs WHERE cs.client_slug = a.client_slug AND cs.patient_phone_hash = a.patient_phone_hash AND cs.opted_out = true) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_dispatches rd WHERE rd.appointment_id = a.id AND rd.reminder_type = 'review_5star' AND rd.status <> 'fallido') ORDER BY a.updated_at ASC;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.to, type: 'text', text: { body: $json.messageText } }) }}

parameters.query: WITH upd AS (UPDATE appointments SET review_requested_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id) INSERT INTO reminder_dispatches (appointment_id, reminder_type, status, provider_message_id) SELECT id, 'review_5star', 'enviado', $2 FROM upd ON CONFLICT (appointment_id, reminder_type) DO UPDATE SET status = 'enviado', provider_message_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.provider_message_id, reminder_dispatches.provider_message_id), dispatched_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE reminder_dispatches.status = 'fallido';
